source.title: Population Registered under the Indian Act by Gender and Residence, 2024

scope_note: Named administrative registry groups in the 2024 report, not a list of all Canadian Indigenous peoples or a count of current governments. The same report distinguishes 619 bands from 634 registry groups. Inuit and Metis require separate sources.
extraction_note: 646 numbered headings were found. The 12 explicitly labeled General list administrative headings are excluded, leaving 634 named registry groups.
